#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool;
use te1_chess::{START_FEN, SearchPosition, Te1Game};
use te1_search::{search, SearchLimits, SearchOptions, SearchResult};
use te1_tt::TranspositionTable;

fn play_all(game: &mut Te1Game, moves: &[&str]) {
    for mv in moves {
        game.play_uci(mv).unwrap();
    }
}

fn set_halfmove_zero(fen: &str) -> String {
    let mut fields: Vec<&str> = fen.split_whitespace().collect();
    assert_eq!(fields.len(), 6);
    fields[4] = "0";
    fields.join(" ")
}

fn histories() -> (Te1Game, Te1Game) {
    let mut a = Te1Game::from_fen(START_FEN).unwrap();
    play_all(
        &mut a,
        &[
            "g1f3", "g8f6", "f3g1", "f6g8",
            "g1f3", "g8f6", "b1c3", "b8c6",
        ],
    );

    let mut seed = Te1Game::from_fen(START_FEN).unwrap();
    play_all(&mut seed, &["g1h3", "b8a6", "b1a3", "g8h6"]);
    let seed_fen = set_halfmove_zero(&seed.fen());
    let mut b = Te1Game::from_fen(&seed_fen).unwrap();
    play_all(
        &mut b,
        &[
            "a3b1", "a6b8", "h3g1", "h6g8",
            "g1f3", "g8f6", "b1c3", "b8c6",
        ],
    );

    let pa = SearchPosition::from_game(&a);
    let pb = SearchPosition::from_game(&b);
    assert!(a.board().same_position(b.board()));
    assert_eq!(pa.halfmove_clock(), 8);
    assert_eq!(pb.halfmove_clock(), 8);
    assert_eq!(pa.repetition_count(), 1);
    assert_eq!(pb.repetition_count(), 1);
    assert_eq!(pa.search_key(), pb.search_key());
    (a, b)
}

fn run(game: &Te1Game, table: Arc<TranspositionTable>, depth: u8) -> SearchResult {
    search(
        game,
        SearchLimits {
            depth: Some(depth),
            ..SearchLimits::default()
        },
        Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
        table,
        SearchOptions {
            threads: 1,
            deterministic: true,
            use_lmr: true,
            use_see_pruning: true,
            use_null_move_pruning: true,
        },
    )
    .unwrap()
}

fn semantic(result: &SearchResult) -> String {
    format!(
        "best={}|score={}|depth={}|pv={}",
        result.best_move.as_deref().unwrap_or("0000"),
        result.score_cp,
        result.depth,
        result.pv.join(",")
    )
}

fn one_direction(
    label: &str,
    warm_source: &Te1Game,
    target: &Te1Game,
    depth: u8,
) -> bool {
    let shared = Arc::new(TranspositionTable::with_megabytes(32));
    let source = run(warm_source, Arc::clone(&shared), depth);
    let warm = run(target, Arc::clone(&shared), depth);
    let cold = run(
        target,
        Arc::new(TranspositionTable::with_megabytes(32)),
        depth,
    );
    let warm_sem = semantic(&warm);
    let cold_sem = semantic(&cold);
    let mismatch = warm_sem != cold_sem;
    println!(
        "TE1_GHI_PRODUCT direction={label} depth={depth} mismatch={mismatch} source_sem={} warm_sem={} cold_sem={} source_nodes={} warm_nodes={} cold_nodes={} warm_tthits={} cold_tthits={}",
        semantic(&source),
        warm_sem,
        cold_sem,
        source.nodes,
        warm.nodes,
        cold.nodes,
        warm.tt_hits,
        cold.tt_hits,
    );
    mismatch
}

fn main() {
    let (a, b) = histories();
    let key = SearchPosition::from_game(&a).search_key();
    let mut mismatches = 0usize;
    let mut total = 0usize;
    for depth in 4..=9 {
        mismatches += usize::from(one_direction("A_to_B", &a, &b, depth));
        total += 1;
        mismatches += usize::from(one_direction("B_to_A", &b, &a, depth));
        total += 1;
    }
    println!(
        "TE1_GHI_PRODUCT_SUMMARY key={key} mismatches={mismatches} total={total}"
    );
}
